desktop.en: Native Pasion OAuth / PKCE; Matrix SDK session.
desktop.zh-cn: 原生 Pasion OAuth / PKCE；Matrix SDK 会话。

server.en: Embedded Pasion; Matrix account provisioning.
server.zh-cn: 内嵌 Pasion，开通 Matrix 账户。

buzz.en: Nostr identity; native key custody and import.
buzz.zh-cn: Nostr 身份，原生密钥保管与导入。

boundary.en: Different identity systems; include key backup and device readiness in onboarding tests.
boundary.zh-cn: 身份体系不同；入门测试需包含密钥备份与设备就绪。

desktop.en: Agent → Agent manager → My Agents → Add Local Agent, after this account is hosted here.
desktop.zh-cn: 本机完成当前账户托管后：Agent → Agent 管理者 → 我的 Agent → 添加本地 Agent。

server.en: Permanent owner and Agent creation policy.
server.zh-cn: 永久所有者与 Agent 创建策略。

buzz.en: Personal agents with recommended harness setup.
buzz.zh-cn: 个人 Agent 与推荐 harness 配置。

boundary.en: Fresh accounts need hosting setup for local execution. Without hosting and pool capability, current main has an onboarding dead end; a guidance fix is prepared separately.
boundary.zh-cn: 新账户需先配置本机托管才能本地执行。当前 main 在无托管且无资源池能力时存在入门断点，另行准备引导修复。

desktop.en: Owner controls settings, execution and removal.
desktop.zh-cn: 所有者控制设置、执行和移除。

server.en: Personal ownership is separate from global administration.
server.zh-cn: 个人所有权与全局管理权限分离。

buzz.en: Agent identity, config and harness management.
buzz.zh-cn: Agent 身份、配置与 harness 管理。

boundary.en: Room access does not transfer ownership.
boundary.zh-cn: 房间访问权限不会转移所有权。

desktop.en: Projects use Matrix Spaces; rooms have independent membership.
desktop.zh-cn: 项目使用 Matrix Space；房间成员独立。

server.en: Space/room verification and bindings.
server.zh-cn: 验证 Space、房间与绑定。

buzz.en: Relay-scoped communities, channels and threads.
buzz.zh-cn: 以中继为范围的社区、频道和线程。

boundary.en: A Space is not a workspace ACL inherited by every room.
boundary.zh-cn: Space 不是所有房间继承的工作区访问控制。

desktop.en: Personal DM; explicit group mentions subject to the bound room policy.
desktop.zh-cn: 个人私聊；群聊明确提及，并遵守绑定房间策略。

server.en: Routes eligible events to the bound executor.
server.zh-cn: 将符合条件的事件路由到绑定执行器。

buzz.en: Mentions, personal chat and workflow triggers.
buzz.zh-cn: 提及、个人聊天与工作流触发。

boundary.en: An unmentioned group message must not silently start a model task.
boundary.zh-cn: 群聊中未提及 Agent 的消息不应悄悄启动模型任务。

desktop.en: Contexts scoped by Agent, room and top-level group thread.
desktop.zh-cn: 上下文按 Agent、房间及群聊顶层线程限定。

server.en: Durable context and dispatch identity.
server.zh-cn: 持久上下文与调度身份。

buzz.en: Conversation and thread context in native agents.
buzz.zh-cn: 原生 Agent 具备对话与线程上下文。

boundary.en: Room membership and another thread must not broaden execution scope.
boundary.zh-cn: 房间成员关系或其他线程不能扩大执行范围。

desktop.en: Native App Server protocol, supported approvals, questions and usage.
desktop.zh-cn: 原生 App Server 协议，支持的审批、问题与用量。

server.en: Executor capability and lease control.
server.zh-cn: 执行器能力与租约控制。

buzz.en: Codex harness available.
buzz.zh-cn: 提供 Codex harness。

boundary.en: Protocol support is not a claim of every interactive CLI feature.
boundary.zh-cn: 协议支持不代表 CLI 每项交互均已对等。

desktop.en: Managed native CLI, structured supported controls.
desktop.zh-cn: 托管原生 CLI，支持结构化控制。

server.en: Qualified executor dispatch.
server.zh-cn: 调度合格执行器。

buzz.en: Claude harness available.
buzz.zh-cn: 提供 Claude harness。

boundary.en: Review platform sandbox and permission policy; do not infer CLI parity.
boundary.zh-cn: 检查平台沙箱与权限策略，不能推定 CLI 对等。

desktop.en: OUP integration lists installed Octos profiles and model choices.
desktop.zh-cn: 通过 OUP 列出实际安装的 Octos 配置与模型。

server.en: Resource configuration is bound to executor capability.
server.zh-cn: 资源配置绑定执行器能力。

buzz.en: The reviewed help does not establish an Octos harness.
buzz.zh-cn: 核验的帮助文档未证明提供 Octos harness。

boundary.en: Keep distinct profiles for the same model; a listed model is not a successful inference test.
boundary.zh-cn: 同名模型的不同配置应保留；列出模型不能证明推理成功。

name.zh-cn: 本地模型与自定义端点

desktop.en: Octos profiles may use local models or custom endpoints.
desktop.zh-cn: Octos 配置可使用本地模型或自定义端点。

server.en: Per-resource accounting; no universal provider identity.
server.zh-cn: 按资源记账，不假设统一供应商身份。

buzz.en: Harness and provider dependent; not scored as absent.
buzz.zh-cn: 取决于 harness 与提供方，不能当作缺失打分。

boundary.en: Expose only the owner-selected profiles; local secrets stay local.
boundary.zh-cn: 只暴露所有者选定配置，本地密钥留在本地。

desktop.en: No complete current native adapter acceptance for these in this audit.
desktop.zh-cn: 本轮未验收这些运行时的完整原生适配。

server.en: Executor protocols do not automatically add an adapter.
server.zh-cn: 执行器协议不会自动增加适配器。

buzz.en: Pi and Goose are documented harnesses.
buzz.zh-cn: 文档列出 Pi 与 Goose harness。

boundary.en: Buzz has broader documented harness coverage; Hermes support is not established here.
boundary.zh-cn: Buzz 的已记录 harness 范围更广；本轮未确认 Hermes 支持。

desktop.en: Owner reviews supported native requests in structured UI.
desktop.zh-cn: 所有者在结构化界面审核支持的原生请求。

server.en: Validates ownership, bound decision and execution authority.
server.zh-cn: 校验所有者、绑定决策与执行权限。

buzz.en: Harness policy and permission controls.
buzz.zh-cn: Harness 策略与权限控制。

boundary.en: Ordinary chat text and room roles are not tool authorization.
boundary.zh-cn: 普通聊天文本和房间角色不能授权工具。

desktop.en: Supported structured questions return to the active runtime.
desktop.zh-cn: 支持的结构化问题返回当前运行时。

server.en: Retains bound operations and receipts.
server.zh-cn: 保留绑定操作与凭据。

buzz.en: Harness interaction support; exact parity needs a matched test.
buzz.zh-cn: 支持 harness 交互，准确对等性需相同任务测试。

boundary.en: Question handling is provider-specific; do not advertise a terminal replacement.
boundary.zh-cn: 问题处理依提供方而异，不宣传为完整终端替代品。

desktop.en: Native Matrix file bridge for Codex and Claude.
desktop.zh-cn: Codex 与 Claude 的原生 Matrix 文件桥接。

server.en: Media and durable authorized file operations.
server.zh-cn: 媒体与持久授权文件操作。

buzz.en: Media and local agent artifacts.
buzz.zh-cn: 媒体与本地 Agent 产物。

boundary.en: Hagency native path caps a request at 64 files / 64 MiB; Octos parity is not established.
boundary.zh-cn: Hagency 原生路径每次最多 64 个文件、64 MiB；未确认 Octos 对等。

desktop.en: Matrix SDK device keys and encrypted Agent room path.
desktop.zh-cn: Matrix SDK 设备密钥与 Agent 加密房间路径。

server.en: Executor-device routing for encrypted Agent work.
server.zh-cn: Agent 加密工作使用执行器设备路由。

buzz.en: The relay accepts NIP-17 gift-wrap events. The native app’s ordinary DM path uses relay-backed kind-9 channel messages.
buzz.zh-cn: 中继接收 NIP-17 gift-wrap 事件；原生应用的普通私聊路径使用中继频道中的 kind-9 消息。

boundary.en: Relay gift-wrap transport support does not establish native DM end-to-end encryption. The native app encryption comparison has been removed.
boundary.zh-cn: 中继对 gift-wrap 传输的支持不能证明原生私聊端到端加密；已移除原生应用加密对比。

desktop.en: Signature-checked SDK discovery guards sendability.
desktop.zh-cn: 通过签名校验的 SDK 发现流程检查可发送性。

server.en: Server key publication alone does not update sender SDK state.
server.zh-cn: 服务器已发布密钥不等于发送方 SDK 已刷新。

buzz.en: Different Nostr key model; no Matrix room-key claim.
buzz.zh-cn: 采用不同的 Nostr 密钥体系，不适用 Matrix 房间密钥结论。

boundary.en: The 30-second helper bound does not guarantee every key-sharing case succeeds.
boundary.zh-cn: 辅助方法的 30 秒边界不保证所有密钥共享情形成功。

desktop.en: Captured provider reports get distinct chat events and duplicate suppression.
desktop.zh-cn: 捕获的提供方报告生成独立聊天事件并去重。

server.en: Delivery-only authorization and reply outbox.
server.zh-cn: 仅投递授权与回复发件箱。

buzz.en: Agent messages in chat; no equivalent matched recovery test run here.
buzz.zh-cn: 聊天中的 Agent 消息；本轮未运行对等恢复测试。

boundary.en: November 17 JIT tested encrypted DM/group and restart with deterministic Codex, not paid inference.
boundary.zh-cn: 11 月 17 日 JIT 用确定性 Codex 验证了加密私聊、群聊与重启，未调用付费推理。

name.zh-cn: 运行结束后的自主消息

desktop.en: ADR 0013 remains partial; native Octos report experiment is disabled.
desktop.zh-cn: ADR 0013 仍部分完成；Octos 原生报告实验关闭。

server.en: Full durable unsolicited routing is not established by current evidence.
server.zh-cn: 当前证据未证明完整的持久主动消息路由。

buzz.en: Schedule/webhook workflows documented.
buzz.zh-cn: 文档记录定时、Webhook 工作流。

boundary.en: Do not claim every autonomous message from every CLI is delivered.
boundary.zh-cn: 不能声称每个 CLI 的所有自主消息均能投递。

name.en: Request an Agent from a pool

desktop.en: Select pool, Agent name and positive token ceiling.
desktop.zh-cn: 选择资源池、Agent 名称与正数 token 上限。

server.en: Current schema-24 applicant-driven contract.
server.zh-cn: 当前 schema 24 由申请人发起的流程。

buzz.en: No equivalent shared-capacity approval contract verified.
buzz.zh-cn: 未核验对等的共享容量审批契约。

boundary.en: One pool per Agent; no prerequisite Project or intermediate reservation in the new flow.
boundary.zh-cn: 每个 Agent 使用一个池；新流程无需预先 Project 或中间预留。

desktop.en: Owner receives and reviews the request.
desktop.zh-cn: 资源所有者接收并审核申请。

server.en: Only selected owner decides; native hold and executor qualification follow.
server.zh-cn: 仅选定所有者决策，之后仍需原生额度保留和执行器资格确认。

buzz.en: Not established in reviewed sources.
buzz.zh-cn: 核验源码未确认。

boundary.en: Approval alone is not a successful hold or a ready worker.
boundary.zh-cn: 批准本身不代表额度已保留或工作器已就绪。

desktop.en: Requires a compatible Server-advertised capability.
desktop.zh-cn: 依赖兼容 Server 宣告的能力。

server.en: Optional management gates; explicit TOML overrides environment defaults.
server.zh-cn: 可选管理开关；显式 TOML 覆盖环境默认值。

buzz.en: No Hagency management API compatibility.
buzz.zh-cn: 不兼容 Hagency 管理 API。

boundary.en: A hidden pool entry may be a server configuration issue, not a missing Desktop feature.
boundary.zh-cn: 资源池入口隐藏可能是服务器配置问题，而非 Desktop 缺功能。

desktop.en: Shows limits, actual use and retained uncertainty.
desktop.zh-cn: 展示限额、实际使用与待确认用量。

server.en: Postpaid reconciliation and retained holds.
server.zh-cn: 事后对账与保留额度。

buzz.en: Agent usage reporting; no equivalent pool ledger claimed.
buzz.zh-cn: Agent 用量报告；未宣称对等资源池账本。

boundary.en: Admitted work may exceed a limit. This is not a hard spending cap or commercial billing.
boundary.zh-cn: 已接纳任务可能超限；并非硬消费上限或商业计费。

desktop.en: Durable commands recover their original operation.
desktop.zh-cn: 持久命令恢复原操作。

server.en: Leases, outbox receipts and generation checks.
server.zh-cn: 租约、发件箱凭据与 generation 检查。

buzz.en: Recovery behavior requires matched testing.
buzz.zh-cn: 恢复行为需要对等测试。

boundary.en: An uncertain result must not trigger a blind replay or be counted as zero usage.
boundary.zh-cn: 结果不确定时不能盲目重放，也不能按零用量计入。

desktop.en: Applicant removes Agent; resource owner can stop supply.
desktop.zh-cn: 申请人移除 Agent，资源所有者可停止供给。

server.en: Fences new execution; retains consumed and unresolved usage.
server.zh-cn: 阻断新执行，保留已消耗和未解决用量。

buzz.en: Harness run controls and configuration.
buzz.zh-cn: Harness 运行控制与配置。

boundary.en: Revocation cannot undo completed tool side effects; stop acknowledgment must be tested.
boundary.zh-cn: 撤销不能撤回已完成工具的副作用，停止确认需要实测。

desktop.en: Reviewed main adds account-aware daemon hosting after rc.13.
desktop.zh-cn: 核验 main 在 rc.13 后加入按账户区分的守护进程托管。

server.en: Each owner/account has separate authority.
server.zh-cn: 每个所有者与账户权限独立。

buzz.en: Community switching has relay-scoped identity and state rules.
buzz.zh-cn: 社区切换遵守中继范围的身份与状态规则。

boundary.en: Do not promise this main-only behavior in the rc.13 installer.
boundary.zh-cn: 不能在 rc.13 安装包中承诺此 main 新行为。

desktop.en: Matrix room membership and standard client transport.
desktop.zh-cn: Matrix 房间成员关系与标准客户端传输。

server.en: Embedded Palpo supports Matrix server-to-server federation.
server.zh-cn: 内嵌 Palpo 支持 Matrix 服务器间联邦。

buzz.en: Community URL is authoritative; relay-scoped tenants, NIP-29/NIP-42.
buzz.zh-cn: 社区 URL 为权威，中继范围租户，NIP-29/NIP-42。

boundary.en: Federation depends on deployment, membership and keys; it does not federate coding-tool authority.
boundary.zh-cn: 联邦取决于部署、成员与密钥，不会联邦共享编程工具权限。

desktop.en: Standard m.room.message text is interoperable.
desktop.zh-cn: 标准 m.room.message 文本可互通。

server.en: Delivers Matrix room events; management is Hagency-specific.
server.zh-cn: 投递 Matrix 房间事件；管理接口为 Hagency 专用。

buzz.en: Nostr/NIP-compatible clients have different interoperability boundaries.
buzz.zh-cn: Nostr/NIP 兼容客户端有不同互通边界。

boundary.en: Element E2E verification was not performed; native approval cards need client-specific UI.
boundary.zh-cn: 尚未执行 Element 端到端验证；原生审批卡片需要专用客户端 UI。

desktop.en: Native Agent experience is separate from server administration.
desktop.zh-cn: 原生 Agent 体验与服务器管理分离。

server.en: Rust/Yew web UI, integrated Palpo and Pasion in one process.
server.zh-cn: Rust/Yew Web UI，一个进程集成 Palpo 与 Pasion。

buzz.en: Relay/server tooling and desktop client.
buzz.zh-cn: 中继、服务器工具与桌面客户端。

boundary.en: No separate Node companion or Fleet pairing is required.
boundary.zh-cn: 无需独立 Node 配套应用或 Fleet 配对。

name.zh-cn: 已发布 Desktop 安装包

desktop.en: rc.13: macOS ARM64 and Windows x86-64. Main prepares rc.14.
desktop.zh-cn: rc.13：macOS ARM64、Windows x86-64；main 准备 rc.14。

server.en: No standalone release binary; source and CI containers.
server.zh-cn: 没有独立发布二进制包；提供源码与 CI 容器。

buzz.en: Desktop releases and platform-specific harness availability.
buzz.zh-cn: 桌面发布版，harness 支持依平台而异。

boundary.en: Old Robrix2 packages are not current Hagency Desktop releases.
boundary.zh-cn: 旧 Robrix2 安装包不是当前 Hagency Desktop 发布版。

desktop.en: No Android or iOS installer in rc.13.
desktop.zh-cn: rc.13 没有 Android 或 iOS 安装包。

server.en: Browser frontend exists; mobile UX not validated here.
server.zh-cn: 提供浏览器前端；本轮未验收其移动端 UX。

buzz.en: Do not infer mobile native parity from desktop sources.
buzz.zh-cn: 不能从桌面源码推定原生移动端对等。

boundary.en: Source/platform support and available installers are different claims.
boundary.zh-cn: 源码平台支持与实际安装包可用性是不同结论。

desktop.en: Coding agents can work in local repositories.
desktop.zh-cn: 编程 Agent 可操作本地仓库。

server.en: No matched native NIP-34-style Git review flow verified.
server.zh-cn: 未核验对等于 NIP-34 的原生 Git 审阅流程。

buzz.en: NIP-34 patches, repositories and status are documented.
buzz.zh-cn: 文档记录 NIP-34 补丁、仓库与状态。

boundary.en: Buzz has a documented product advantage here; a CLI returning a patch is not equivalent UX.
boundary.zh-cn: Buzz 在此有已记录的产品优势；CLI 返回补丁不等于相同 UX。

desktop.en: No full native YAML workflow builder established in this audit.
desktop.zh-cn: 本轮未确认完整原生 YAML 工作流构建器。

server.en: Agent dispatch is not a workflow-builder parity claim.
server.zh-cn: Agent 调度不等于工作流构建器对等。

buzz.en: YAML message, reaction, schedule and webhook workflows.
buzz.zh-cn: YAML 消息、反应、定时和 Webhook 工作流。

boundary.en: Buzz has broader documented automation; no fabricated Hagency parity.
boundary.zh-cn: Buzz 的已记录自动化更广，不能虚构 Hagency 对等。

desktop.en: Mini-apps and webviews exist; no matched collaborative canvas acceptance.
desktop.zh-cn: 具备小应用与 WebView；未完成对等协作画布验收。

server.en: No equivalent canvas contract established.
server.zh-cn: 未确认等价画布契约。

buzz.en: Channels and direct-message canvases are documented.
buzz.zh-cn: 文档记录频道与私信画布。

boundary.en: A mini-app container is not a substitute for a tested shared canvas workflow.
boundary.zh-cn: 小应用容器不能替代已验证的共享画布工作流。

desktop.en: No equivalent core Agent voice workflow verified.
desktop.zh-cn: 未核验对等的核心 Agent 语音工作流。

server.en: No matched voice task acceptance.
server.zh-cn: 没有对等语音任务验收。

buzz.en: Current help documents voice huddles and agent participation.
buzz.zh-cn: 当前帮助文档记录语音 huddle 与 Agent 参与。

boundary.en: Use current Buzz help, not its older incomplete-huddles README summary.
boundary.zh-cn: 依据 Buzz 当前帮助，不能挑选旧 README 的未完成描述。

desktop.en: Historical encrypted real-stack JIT evidence is dated separately.
desktop.zh-cn: 历史加密真实链路 JIT 证据单独标注日期。

server.en: Pinned-main CI and local container smoke have separate results.
server.zh-cn: 固定 main CI 与本地容器 smoke 分别记录结果。

buzz.en: Source-reviewed here; no same-task native live benchmark yet.
buzz.zh-cn: 本轮做源码核验，尚无相同任务的原生真实基准。

boundary.en: A score above 90 or an overall win requires repeatable task evidence for both products.
boundary.zh-cn: 90 分以上或整体胜出需要双方可重复的任务证据。
